in_marathi.name: Deelip
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deelip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Deelip is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deep' which means 'a lamp' or 'a deep container'. The suffix 'lip' means 'shining' or 'radiant'. Therefore, Deelip can be interpreted as 'one who shines like a lamp'. This name is often given to children born in families where knowledge and wisdom are highly valued.
